files.memories/extensions/timeline/instruction:
# Timeline

This folder belongs to the Timeline recorder in Aex Computer Use (ACUA).

ACUA records a local event stream of your activity and keeps it on this Mac. It has no language model of its own, so it does not write activity summaries here. A tool you choose may place its own summaries in the resources folder next to this file.

Nothing in this folder is sent anywhere by ACUA.
